name: Ninja Health -Moshimo Kanojo-tachi ga Fuuzokujou Nara?-
original_name: 忍者ヘルス -もしも彼女達が風俗嬢なら?-
source:
The long war was fully over, and peace settled in the pagoda.
However, this left the female ninjas unemployed.
Struggling to find a place in the new economy, they applied their unique skills of stealth and cunning
to the commerce of love, in the shadows of the red light district.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138313.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
漫长的战争彻底结束，塔楼恢复和平。然而，女忍者们因此失业。她们努力寻找新经济中的位置，把隐秘与狡诈的独特技能用于红灯区的爱情生意。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138313.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
